#Hinge
descriptionPlain:
Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted

In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.


About the Role
 
As a key member of our Android team, you will play a vital role in developing and maintaining the Hinge Android mobile application. Your focus will be on implementing new product features, fixing issues, and improving the mobile application user experience. All while leveraging the latest Android tools such as Kotlin, jetpack compose, coroutines, room, hilt and many more. Collaborating within a cross-disciplinary team, including product managers, technical project managers, designers, data engineers, backend engineers, and QA specialists, you will work closely with the Tech Lead and peers to advance our product and contribute to our engineering community. This role offers the opportunity to do high-impact work, directly contributing to a consumer mobile application used by millions. Over time you can expect to grow into an independent, capable, and confident Android developer.

lists.content:
• Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration: Work closely with a diverse team of developers, designers, and product managers to build features that prioritize high quality and user engagement.
  • Kotlin Proficiency: Develop and continuously enhance your understanding of Kotlin fundamentals, applying them to create efficient and effective solutions.
  • Android Expertise: Gain a thorough understanding of Android development principles and design patterns, applying them to build intuitive and user-friendly applications.
  • Issue Resolution: Triage, debug, and effectively resolve software issues, ensuring the stability and performance of our application.
  • Codebase Stewardship: Actively contribute to the long-term health and evolution of the codebase, implementing best practices and innovative solutions.
  • Code Reviews: Regularly perform code reviews, providing constructive feedback to peers to foster a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Active Team Participation: Engage actively in team ceremonies such as stand-ups, planning sessions, and retrospectives to ensure alignment and promote agile methodologies.
  • Effective Communication: Maintain clear and positive communication with team members and other departments, supporting an empowering and inclusive team environment.

• Professional Android Development Experience: You have 2-5 years of experience in Android development, demonstrating the ability to design and implement mobile applications effectively.
  • Google Play Publication: You have experience publishing at least one application on the Google Play Store, showcasing your understanding of the deployment process and maintaining a production application.
  • Proficiency in Kotlin and Android SDKs: You are proficient in Kotlin, which is strongly preferred, and have a good understanding of Android SDKs and frameworks. Experience with Java in the context of Android development is also beneficial.
  • Solid Software Development Fundamentals: You possess a good foundation in software development principles and are capable of creating efficient and maintainable code.
  • Strong Communication Skills: You are able to communicate clearly and effectively, facilitating productive collaborations within technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ownership and Quality Focus: You take pride in your work and are committed to creating high-quality user experiences, demonstrating attention to detail and a user-centric approach to application development.

descriptionPlain:
Our Mission
 
As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing.
 
We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more.
 
Our Values
Take the Lead
We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
Move Fast
We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
Better Together
We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
Real Talk
We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
Safety First
We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
Spark Fun
We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.


Program Duration
The internship program will run from June 1 through August 28, 2026.
 
Where you’ll work
This is a hybrid role that requires in-office collaboration three days per week in either Los Angeles or Palo Alto, California. 
 
About the Role 
As an Android Engineer Intern, you’ll collaborate with senior engineers to design, build, and ship features that impact millions of users. You’ll work within a highly collaborative, technical environment focused on improving architecture, exploring new technologies, and delivering a world-class app experience.

About Tinder

Tinder connects people. 
With tens of millions of users and a presence in nearly every country on Earth, our reach is expansive—and growing fast.

The Globalization team sits within Product Operations and plays a critical role in shaping how we connect with people worldwide. We enable culturally relevant, hyper-localized experiences by partnering across product, design, content, and marketing to ensure Tinder resonates across borders and languages.


About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced and strategically minded Senior Localization Program Manager to drive Tinder’s localization efforts across APAC.

Reporting to the Sr. Manager of Globalization & International Growth, this role will work closely with another Program Manager to operationalize the team’s global strategy within the region — ensuring our products, content, and campaigns are not just translated, but truly built for local relevance and impact.

You’ll serve as a regional program lead, connecting cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Design to integrate localization early in development, optimize workflows, and surface insights that inform global decisions.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of program management, technical localization, and cultural strategy, and who can scale processes across multiple markets while staying attuned to local nuance.

Reporting to the Sr. Manager of Globalization & International Growth, this role will work closely with another Program Manager to operationalize the team’s global strategy within the region — ensuring our products, content, and campaigns are not just translated, but truly built for local relevance and impact.

You’ll serve as a regional program lead, connecting cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Design to integrate localization early in development, optimize workflows, and surface insights that inform global decisions.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of program management, technical localization, and cultural strategy, and who can scale processes across multiple markets while staying attuned to local nuance.

lists.content:
• Drive regional localization execution and strategy alignment: Own the end-to-end localization program for APAC, translating global strategy into regional priorities and scalable programs.
  • Act as a regional thought partner: Collaborate with the Sr. Manager of Globalization and the broader Globalization team to shape initiatives that advance Tinder’s global readiness and user experience.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Build strong relationships with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Design, and Data to integrate localization into roadmaps and launch cycles, influencing decisions with regional insights.
  • Partner with regional Marketing leads and the VP of APAC Marketing to support Go-To-Market Asia efforts—ensuring on-time delivery of localized assets, efficient production workflows, and seamless execution of high-impact campaigns across markets.
  • Optimize localization operations: Assess and refine workflows, tools, and automation (TMS, CAT, QA automation, connectors) to enhance efficiency, transparency, and quality.
  • Support internationalization efforts: Partner with engineering to identify and address i18n issues, ensuring scalability and long-term product readiness across languages.
  • Program governance: Establish and track KPIs to measure localization performance, cost efficiency, and quality outcomes.
  • Vendor and resource management: Oversee localization vendors and freelance linguists, driving accountability, innovation, and high-quality output.
  • Mentorship and enablement: Collaborate closely with Language Managers and other Program Managers to ensure alignment, mentorship, and consistent process execution across regions.
  • Cultural intelligence: Stay ahead of cultural trends, linguistic shifts, and user behaviors across APAC markets to guide creative and product decisions.

• 5+ years of experience in localization program management, international operations, or a related function within a tech, product, or global brand environment.
  • Proven success managing complex, multi-market localization programs across APAC.
  • Deep understanding of localization technology ecosystems (TMS, CAT, QA automation) and internationalization fundamentals.
  • Strong program management skills — from scoping and prioritization to stakeholder communication and risk mitigation.
  • Experience influencing product and marketing decisions through data, insights, and user empathy.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills and a collaborative mindset; comfortable working across technical and creative teams.
  • Self-starter with strong ownership, adaptability, and attention to detail.
  • Fluent in English

• Experience localizing mobile apps or digital platforms, particularly in dating, social, or lifestyle categories.
  • Familiarity with Tinder’s tone, brand voice, and youth culture positioning.
  • Technical literacy in APIs, localization connectors, or automation scripting.
  • Fluency in at least one APAC language (e.g., Japanese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, Hindi, etc.).
  • Experience supporting go-to-market or regional marketing campaigns across diverse APAC markets.

descriptionPlain:
Pairs（ペアーズ）は日本最大級マッチングアプリであり、理想のパートナーを探す累計登録数2700万以上のユーザーが利用しています。（25年現在）20以上のブランドを多言語で提供するMatch Groupの一部として、グループで培ったノウハウを活用して、グローバル展開を進めています。
ミッションである「人生に”あってよかった”と思ってもらえるものを」に向かってプロダクト開発部は日々躍進しており、生涯のパートナーを見つけるお手伝いになるよう、ユーザーがワクワクする新機能のリリースを重ねています。
 
Pairs is the leading online dating app in Japan, and has been used by over 27 million users looking for their ideal partner. Part of Match Group, Pairs has access to the collective wisdom and resources of a global dating app portfolio, and further expansion outside Japan is a continued goal for the company.
 
Our mission is to provide a life-changing service that our users will remember fondly after finding their life partner. Product development at Pairs is ever active in driving forward this mission, with frequent releases that offer users exciting new ways to achieve their dating goals. 
 
Job Summary
 
プロダクトバックエンドチームの一員として、Pairsの新規機能開発の最前線に立ち、プロジェクトの成功、ビジネス成果、そしてユーザーの幸福に直接的な影響を与えます。Match Groupの一部として、国際的なブランドや同僚と一緒に働く機会があります。
 
プロダクトマネージャーやフロントエンドエンジニア、その他の同僚との日々のコラボレーションが業務のドライバーになります。MySQL、DynamoDB、Redis、Elasticsearchを含めた多様な技術スタックを活用したバックエンドソリューションを設計から実装まで担当し、Pairsユーザーが理想のパートナーを見つけるためのリリースを行います。
 
バックエンドチームと一緒にデザインドキュメントやプルリクエストのレビューを行い、コードベースとチームのプラクティスの継続的な改善に貢献します。他のチームと頻繁にコラボレーションをして新たな挑戦を見つけ出し、組織に影響を与える機会を自ら作らせることができます。
 
Being a part of the product back-end team puts you front and center of feature development at Pairs. Your input and contributions will directly influence the success of projects, business outcomes, and user happiness. As a part of Match Group, you’ll have opportunities to work with international brands and colleagues.
 
Daily collaboration with product managers, front-end engineers, and other colleagues will drive the direction of your work. You’ll utilize a tech stack including MySQL, DynamoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, and many other technologies to design scalable back-end solutions, and write and deploy the code that helps Pairs users find their ideal partner. 
 
Together with the back-end team, you’ll review design docs and pull requests, and contribute to continually improving the codebase and team practices. Frequent opportunities to collaborate with other members and teams allow you to find new challenges, and leave an impact on the wider organization.

descriptionPlain:
Our Mission
 
As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing.
 
We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more.
 
Our Values
Take the Lead
We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
Move Fast
We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
Better Together
We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
Real Talk
We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
Safety First
We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
Spark Fun
We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.


Program Duration
The internship program will run from June 1 through August 28, 2026.
 
Where you’ll work
This is a hybrid role that requires in-office collaboration three days per week in either Los Angeles or Palo Alto, California. 
 
About the Role 
As a Backend Engineer Intern at Tinder, you will partner directly with senior members of the engineering team and be empowered to contribute solutions to Tinder’s backend system. We are deeply invested in improving architecture design, exploring and leveraging new technologies in interesting ways to deliver an app that continues to shape how people connect globally.

lists.content:
• Collaborate across Tinder Engineering on the expansion of our service platform.
  • Develop and operate scalable and resilient distributed services that run on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • Build large scale distributed systems that handle billions of data events a day.
  • Write unit and integration tests. 
  • Access to cutting-edge Generative AI tools and the opportunity to apply them in real-world engineering work.

• Aspiring backend developer who’s excited to work on large scale challenges with cutting-edge technology.
  • Proficiency in coding with at least one language (Java, Scala, Python,Typescript, Nodejs, etc.).
  • Foundational knowledge of basic Computer Science principles: data structures and algorithms.
  • Curiosity and creativity in leveraging Generative AI to reimagine feature building and development workflows.
  • Currently pursuing a BS/BA, MS, or PhD in Computer Science or a related field.

• Prior internship or work experience on backend systems.
  • Completed relevant project experience (i.e. hackathons, personal projects, GitHub, Open Source, volunteer coding experience etc.).
  • Knowledge of technologies such as; Protocol Buffers, gRPC, Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, ElasticSearch, Redis.
  • Aware of AWS technologies like; DynamoDB, S3, RDS, ElastiCache.

With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing.
 
We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more.
 
Our Values

Take the Lead
We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.

Move Fast
We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.

Better Together
We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.

Real Talk
We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.

Safety First
We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.

Spark Fun
We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.

description:
Know where you belong.
 
At Match Group, we are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Benefits Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will play a key part in supporting the administration and compliance of our U.S. benefits programs, ensuring
efficient communication and operational processes, and contributing to continuous improvement
initiatives. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, a customer-centric mindset, and the
ability to collaborate with both internal and external partners to drive success in all areas of benefits
administration.
 
This role is hybrid (in office Tuesday–Thursday) out of our Dallas, TX office.

lists.content:
• Benefits Communication: Partner with internal and external stakeholders to develop, promote,
and distribute clear, timely benefits communications to ensure employees are informed about available offerings and changes.
• Data Accuracy & Audits: Conduct regular audits to verify data integrity between Workday, payroll, and benefits carriers, resolving discrepancies as needed.
• Billing & Invoice Management: Acts as the primary backup in benefits billing by reconciling invoices, creating purchase orders, and processing payments, ensuring accuracy and timely submission.
• Program Administration: Assist in the development, implementation, and day-to-day management of comprehensive U.S.benefits programs, including medical, dental, vision, FSA, life insurance, disability, COBRA, and other perks.
• Vendor Coordination: Manage data integration and work closely with benefits vendors to resolve enrollment issues and improve operational processes.
• Employee Support: Respond to employee inquiries regarding benefits, investigate issues, identify trends, and provide timely resolutions.
• Compliance Support: Ensure full adherence to government regulations and plan provisions, conducting audits, non-discrimination testing, required filings, and ACA reporting to maintain
compliance across all benefit plans.
• Process Improvement: Assist in identifying opportunities for process enhancements, collaborating on the development of more efficient benefits administration procedures.
• Special Projects & Research: Support research initiatives, benefit events, and special projects aimed at optimizing benefits offerings and administration.

• At least 3 years of benefits administration experience required.
• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent work experience) preferred.
• A solid understanding of benefit plan(s) principles, COBRA, ERISA, HIPAA, FMLA, and other domestic regulations related to benefits is required.
• Proficiency in Workday is highly preferred.
• Strong MS Office skills (Strong Excel) required.
• Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a collaborative, fast-paced team environment.
• Demonstrated ability to work well with team members and business colleagues in the delivery of benefit initiatives as assigned.

descriptionPlain:
Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted

In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.


About the Role 
We are looking for a Data Privacy Specialist to join our newly established Data + Privacy Operations team within the Critical Response & Enterprise Risk function. In this role, you will own the operational handling of sensitive privacy and security requests submitted by users, regulators, and internal stakeholders — including Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs), data deletion requests, privacy law inquiries, and security-related claims.
 
You'll bring strong analytical thinking and operational rigor to ensuring our responses meet global regulatory requirements and internal compliance standards. You'll also play an active role in improving the workflows, documentation, and tooling that help us scale our privacy operations responsibly.

lists.content:
• Own Privacy Request Handling: Manage and resolve user-initiated DSARs, data deletion requests, and other privacy-related inquiries end-to-end — from identity verification and data validation to case documentation and escalation to Match Group Privacy when required

  • Ensure Regulatory Compliance: Process requests in alignment with global privacy regulations including GDPR, Brazil LGPD, and CCPA/CPRA, monitoring deadlines and maintaining consistent handling standards to mitigate legal, regulatory, and reputational risk

  • Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Privacy, Legal, Data Engineering, and Security teams to investigate and resolve complex requests, escalating cases involving potential security breaches or regulatory complaints as needed

  • Maintain Queue & Risk Management: Manage incoming DPS tickets while maintaining SLA compliance, prioritizing high-risk requests, and proactively flagging risks or backlogs to leadership

  • Improve Operations at Scale: Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve tooling, and automate processes — while maintaining and updating internal knowledge bases and procedural documentation

  • Contribute to Organizational Insight: Develop deep knowledge of internal data pipelines, privacy policies, and safety systems, and provide leadership with operational insights on trends, emerging risks, and process improvements

• 2+ years of experience in a user-facing role in privacy operations, trust & safety, risk operations, compliance, or data governance
  • Familiarity with global privacy regulations including GDPR, LGPD, and CCPA/CPRA
  • Experience handling sensitive or high-risk user requests with strong attention to detail
  • Strong analytical and investigative skills with the ability to work cross-functionally with technical and legal stakeholders
  • Excellent written communication and documentation skills
  • Nice to have: Experience processing DSARs or regulatory privacy requests; familiarity with data systems or data retrieval workflows; background in Trust & Safety, customer escalations, or compliance operations; experience in a global technology or platform environment

descriptionPlain:
Our Mission:
 
Launched in 2012, Tinder® revolutionized how people meet, growing from 1 match to one billion matches in just two years. This rapid growth demonstrates its ability to fulfill a fundamental human need: real connection. Today, the app has been downloaded over 630 million times, leading to over 97 billion matches, serving approximately 50 million users per month in 190 countries and 45+ languages - a scale unmatched by any other app in the category. In 2024, Tinder won four Effie Awards for its first-ever global brand campaign, “It Starts with a Swipe”™
 
 
Our Values
Take the Lead
We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
Move Fast
We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
Better Together
We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
Real Talk
We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
Safety First
We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
Spark Fun
We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.


The Team
The Analytics team is looking for curious individuals excited to drive data-informed decision-making at Tinder. We are a strategic partner to Product, Design, Engineering, and Machine Learning, using our comprehensive datasets to develop experiments, understand and evolve metrics, build automated reporting, and generate exploratory insights that guide business and product decisions. These insights are key to both the performance of our business and the experience of our members.
We are hiring Data Scientists into a shared pipeline with opportunities to join one of several product pods, including Core, Recommendations, and Growth.
Core focuses on the end-to-end member experience across registration, swiping, matching, and messaging, ensuring a healthy, engaging marketplace.
Recommendations focuses on ranking, personalization, and signals to surface the right profiles and experiences at the right time.
Growth focuses on validating new “greenspace” hypotheses, acquisition, activation, and lifecycle experiences (including messaging and channels) that help members discover more value on Tinder.
During the interview process, we’ll work closely with you to determine which pod is the best match based on your background, interests, and our current needs.
 
Where you’ll work:
This position can be located in Los Angeles, San Francisco, Palo Alto, CA, or Dallas, TX

  • Find the “story” in the data and share insights with product, engineering, design, and machine learning partners, as well as at a company level.
  • Be an authority with a point of view for the organization, using data to continually challenge and reshape our understanding of member behavior and business performance.
  • Derive and communicate data‑driven recommendations on both the prioritization of potential initiatives and the performance of current features and experiments.
  • Define and operationalize metrics at the company-, team-, and product-level via rollout tables, dashboards, and automated reporting.

• Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (or equivalent experience); Master’s degree or PhD with a social science background preferred.
  • 2–4 years of professional experience in Data Science and/or Analytics.
  • Familiarity with two‑sided consumer ecosystems, ideally within consumer technology or marketplaces.
  • Experience with SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau or Mode).
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing experiments (e.g., randomized tests, A/B tests) to drive key product decisions.
  • Familiarity with Python or R, using descriptive and inferential statistics and machine learning models.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with design, product, engineering, and/or machine learning teams to move initiatives from concept to launch.
  • Ability to develop a nuanced business understanding, frame testable hypotheses, and extract meaningful findings from data.
  • Ability to present data, insights, and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Deep curiosity about how things work—from both a business and technical perspective—that leads you to identify and explore new product opportunities, improve data infrastructure, and dive deeply into understanding member behavior.
  • Proactive collaborator who engages cross-functional partners (Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, Design, Marketing) to influence decision-making, and who is comfortable voicing concerns and alternative perspectives.
  • Ability to prioritize across multiple projects, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and communicate timelines and risks clearly to stakeholders.

opening:
Our Mission:
 
Launched in 2012, Tinder® revolutionized how people meet, growing from 1 match to one billion matches in just two years. This rapid growth demonstrates its ability to fulfill a fundamental human need: real connection. Today, the app has been downloaded over 630 million times, leading to over 97 billion matches, serving approximately 50 million users per month in 190 countries and 45+ languages - a scale unmatched by any other app in the category. In 2024, Tinder won four Effie Awards for its first-ever global brand campaign, “It Starts with a Swipe”™
 
 
Our Values

Take the Lead
We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.

Move Fast
We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.

Better Together
We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.

Real Talk
We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.

Safety First
We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.

Spark Fun
We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.

descriptionBody:
The Team

The Analytics team is looking for curious individuals excited to drive data-informed decision-making at Tinder. We are a strategic partner to Product, Design, Engineering, and Machine Learning, using our comprehensive datasets to develop experiments, understand and evolve metrics, build automated reporting, and generate exploratory insights that guide business and product decisions. These insights are key to both the performance of our business and the experience of our members.

We are hiring Data Scientists into a shared pipeline with opportunities to join one of several product pods, including Core, Recommendations, and Growth.

  • Core focuses on the end-to-end member experience across registration, swiping, matching, and messaging, ensuring a healthy, engaging marketplace.

  • Recommendations focuses on ranking, personalization, and signals to surface the right profiles and experiences at the right time.

  • Growth focuses on validating new “greenspace” hypotheses, acquisition, activation, and lifecycle experiences (including messaging and channels) that help members discover more value on Tinder.

During the interview process, we’ll work closely with you to determine which pod is the best match based on your background, interests, and our current needs.

 
Where you’ll work:
This position can be located in Los Angeles, San Francisco, Palo Alto, CA, or Dallas, TX

#Hinge
descriptionPlain:
Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted

In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.


About the Role
Hinge is hiring a Director of Product Management to lead our User Growth product area. You will set the vision and strategy for how Hinge acquires, activates, and retains users at scale, spanning onboarding, new user activation, international expansion, and lifecycle engagement. This is a senior leadership role with significant scope: you'll manage a team of product managers, own top-line growth metrics, and partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Marketing to ship high-impact product experiences.
 
This is an ideal role for a proven consumer growth leader who is equally comfortable in the weeds of an experiment and in the boardroom presenting strategy — someone who leads with data, builds with empathy, and thrives on the challenge of making dating work better for millions of people.

  • Deep experience in consumer growth, acquisition, onboarding, retention, or engagement — with a strong track record of measurable impact
  • Strong analytical mindset; comfortable driving decisions from data while maintaining sharp product intuition
  • Experience running a high-velocity experimentation culture across a team
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence without authority across engineering, data science, design, and marketing
  • Clear, confident communicator who can operate at both the strategic and tactical level
  • Passion for Hinge's mission of helping people build meaningful relationships

Our Accounting team is seeking a Director, Equity Accounting to serve as the definitive leader for the end-to-end accounting, valuation, and forecasting of our global equity incentive plans. This is a high-impact, Dallas-based role where you will act as a strategic advisor to senior leadership, ensuring our complex equity structures are technically sound and compliant.
 
At Match Group, we help millions of singles find meaningful relationships through our diverse portfolio of brands, including Match, Hinge, OkCupid, Plenty of Fish, and more. With a presence in over 190 countries, our reach is expansive-and growing fast. We're driven by a shared mission: to spark connections that transform lives. From behavioral science to machine learning, we apply deep thinking and innovative approaches to the complex dynamics of human connection.
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life.  We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL in our Dallas office three days a week.

lists.content:
• Strategic Financial Ownership: Lead the end-to-end accounting, valuation, and forecasting for all global equity incentive plans. You are the definitive subject matter expert for ASC 718 and ASC 260 and the primary architect of the equity-related financial statement disclosures.

  • Executive Advisory & Board Reporting: Partner closely with the SVP of Financial Reporting, Legal Counsel, and the People Team. You will prepare and present high-level analysis on plan availability, burn rates, and the financial impact of proposed equity structures.

  • Global Mobility & Tax Compliance: Serve as the internal authority on the complexities of a modern workforce. You will oversee the logic for state and international mobility, ensuring that cross-border tax withholding and reporting are technically sound and compliant with local jurisdictions.

  • Advanced Forecasting & Modeling: Own the "Equity Crystal Ball." You will develop sophisticated models to forecast SBC expense, diluted shares impact, and cash flow requirements under multiple "what-if" scenarios.

  • Audit & Control Leadership: Set the standard for SOX compliance within the equity function. You will lead the relationship with external auditors, defending technical positions on valuations, and award modifications.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as the bridge between Finance, People/HR, and Legal. You will be the Accounting voice at the table providing insights into the accounting impact of daily decisions.

  • Team Mentorship: Directly manage and develop a Manager-level professional, fostering a culture of technical excellence, career growth, and extreme attention to detail.

  • Other Areas: ESPP, Section 16 filings

lists.text: We may be a Match if:
lists.content:
• Experience: 8-12+ years of progressive accounting experience, with 3-5+ years specifically focused on equity accounting.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Accounting.

  • Certification: Active CPA is required.

  • Technical knowledge: Mastery of US GAAP, specifically ASC 718 and ASC 260

  • Soft Skills: Exceptional communication, critical thinking, and the ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

• Public accounting background

  • Certified Equity Professional

  • M&A experience with equity treatment

  • Shareworks and OneStream experience

  • SEC Reporting experience

lists.content:
• Strategic Partner to Leaders: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, shaping organizational strategy through a people lens. Ground recommendations in business context, org health, and long-term capability needs while helping leaders think in systems rather than symptoms.
  • Org Design & Ways of Working: Lead complex organizational design efforts that clarify roles, decision rights, and operating rhythms. Partner with leadership to evolve structures, spans/layers, and cross-functional collaboration models that enable the business to scale effectively.
  • Leadership & Manager Development: Coach senior leaders and managers to strengthen leadership effectiveness, decision-making, and team performance. Partner with L&D to scale leadership development and manager capability across the organization.
  • Talent & Performance: Drive talent strategy for the organization, including performance calibration, development planning, and succession planning for critical roles. Partner with People Ops to ensure performance and compensation processes are transparent, equitable, and aligned with business outcomes.
  • Change Leadership: Lead thoughtful change initiatives including reorganizations, strategic shifts, and team evolution. Design pragmatic change plans with clear communication, stakeholder alignment, and strong adoption.
  • Team Effectiveness & Culture: Diagnose systemic challenges impacting team health or performance and partner with leaders to strengthen psychological safety, accountability, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Employee Relations: Navigate complex and sensitive employee matters in partnership with Legal and People Ops. Proactively identify organizational risks and coach leaders to address issues early and constructively.
  • Special Projects: Lead high-impact, cross-functional initiatives that improve how the organization operates—from talent systems to leadership practices.
  • Learning & Development: Identify capability gaps and partner with L&D to design programs and experiences that build the leadership and functional capabilities needed for the organization’s next stage of growth.
  • Data-driven Insights: Translate engagement, talent, and organizational data into clear insights and executive-ready narratives that inform decision-making and drive action.

• Experience: 12+ years as an HRBP / People Partner, including experience partnering with senior leaders in Marketing, Brand, Creative, or Growth organizations. Demonstrated depth in organizational design, executive coaching, and talent strategy within fast-paced, high-growth, or tech-enabled environments.
  • Change Leadership & Systems Thinking: Demonstrated ability to connect dots across teams, anticipate second-order impacts, and lead complex organizational change. Experience designing and scaling people programs that drive measurable business impact.
  • Executive Coaching & Advising: Proven ability to coach and influence senior leaders in dynamic, performance-driven environments—balancing ambitious outcomes with sustainable team health and long-term organizational effectiveness.
  • Influence & Communication: Strong data fluency and strategic storytelling ability. Exceptional communication and influencing skills with the ability to translate people insights into clear recommendations that drive alignment and action across senior stakeholders.
  • Nice to have: Formal coaching certification or background; experience supporting Marketing or other creative, consumer-facing organizations at scale; experience leading enterprise-level talent processes such as performance, talent planning, or engagement programs.

descriptionPlain:
Our Mission:
 
Launched in 2012, Tinder® revolutionized how people meet, growing from 1 match to one billion matches in just two years. This rapid growth demonstrates its ability to fulfill a fundamental human need: real connection. Today, the app has been downloaded over 630 million times, leading to over 97 billion matches, serving approximately 50 million users per month in 190 countries and 45+ languages - a scale unmatched by any other app in the category. In 2024, Tinder won four Effie Awards for its first-ever global brand campaign, “It Starts with a Swipe”™
 
 
Our Values
Take the Lead
We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
Move Fast
We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
Better Together
We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
Real Talk
We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
Safety First
We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
Spark Fun
We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.


Tinder is at a pivotal moment. We’re building on our swipe-based experience to create more meaningful, real-world connections rooted in trust and authentic self-expression
This shift requires a deeper, more actionable understanding of human behavior, relationships, and social dynamics. UX Research is central to that transformation.
The Director of UX Research leads the research function at Tinder with direct influence on product direction, company priorities, and long-term bets. You will identify the most important unknowns, synthesize signals across research, data, and customer input, and create conviction around where to go next.
This is not a service role. This is a decision-making function. And this is a rebuild moment—you will define how research operates, where it focuses, and how it drives impact across the company.
Tinder sits at the intersection of culture, relationships, and technology. Few products generate as much opinion—or have as much impact on people’s lives.
This role defines how a global company listens, learns, and decides. You will shape not just what we build, but how we understand the humans we build for—and how that understanding drives meaningful, real-world connection.

descriptionBody:
Tinder is at a pivotal moment. We’re building on our swipe-based experience to create more meaningful, real-world connections rooted in trust and authentic self-expression

This shift requires a deeper, more actionable understanding of human behavior, relationships, and social dynamics. UX Research is central to that transformation.

The Director of UX Research leads the research function at Tinder with direct influence on product direction, company priorities, and long-term bets. You will identify the most important unknowns, synthesize signals across research, data, and customer input, and create conviction around where to go next.

This is not a service role. This is a decision-making function. And this is a rebuild moment—you will define how research operates, where it focuses, and how it drives impact across the company.

Tinder sits at the intersection of culture, relationships, and technology. Few products generate as much opinion—or have as much impact on people’s lives.

This role defines how a global company listens, learns, and decides. You will shape not just what we build, but how we understand the humans we build for—and how that understanding drives meaningful, real-world connection.

lists.content:
• Develop and own Tinder’s global social media strategy, grounded in cultural relevance, platform expertise, consumer insights, and business goals.
  • Rebuild and reinvent Tinder’s social presence with a fresh POV, modern brand voice, and platform-specific identities.
  • Build frameworks for content planning, trend forecasting, calendars, workflows, and measurement.
  • Lead the creation of thumb-stopping, conversation-driving social content across all platforms.
  • Partner closely with Brand, Media, and Product Marketing to ensure social reinforces brand storytelling and campaign moments.
  • Oversee creator collaborations, influencer strategy, and social-first partnerships.
  • Build a rigorous analytics discipline across platforms
  • Use data to guide content decisions, trend identification, resource allocation, and optimizations.
  • Build and maintain reporting dashboards for leadership visibility.
  • Manage and mentor a team of Social Managers, Influencer Leads, and Community Leads, while developing scalable strategies to grow impact and reach.
  • Foster a culture of creativity, experimentation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as the primary social voice across the company, partnering with Brand, Media, Comms, Product Marketing, and Legal.
  • Develop agile processes for real-time reactions, cultural moments, crisis management, and proactive storytelling.
  •

• 8–10+ years of experience in social media strategy, content leadership, or digital marketing.
  • Demonstrated success owning social strategies for challenger brands. 
  • Proven ability to revamp or rebuild social from the ground up — shaping voice, identity, content streams, and systems.
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, IG, X, YouTube, and emerging platforms: algorithms, formats, best practices, and cultural nuance.
  • Strong analytical mindset with experience using dashboards, social listening, insights tools, and performance modeling.
  • Exceptional people leadership skills with experience managing and growing teams.
  • A creative thinker obsessed with culture: memes, dating trends, internet humor, creators, moments, and storytelling.

descriptionPlain:
Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted

In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.


About the Role
 
We are seeking a Director, Talent Acquisition to lead the Talent Acquisition organization and serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership. This role owns talent acquisition strategy and outcomes across the company, shapes long-range workforce planning, and ensures hiring strategies materially support business growth and capability needs. The Director operates with a thoughtful, data-driven approach to enterprise hiring strategy, workforce planning, and TA operations, balancing urgency with long-term business impact.
 
The Director owns capacity planning, headcount forecasting, and TA resource allocation in close partnership with Finance and People leadership. This role sets scalable recruiting standards and operating models, ensures strong offer governance and market alignment, and strengthens Hinge’s ability to attract, assess, and hire top talent in a competitive market.

lists.content:
Leadership & Team Management
  • Lead, mentor, and develop TA leaders and senior individual contributors, fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture.
  • Own organizational workforce and capacity planning to ensure scalable coverage aligned to business priorities.
  • Set performance standards, accountability frameworks, and leadership norms across the TA organization.
  • Provide ongoing coaching and feedback to support leader development, succession planning, and organizational health.
    •  
    Strategic Talent Acquisition
  • Own and shape talent acquisition strategy in partnership with executives and senior leaders, translating business strategy into long-range workforce and hiring plans.
  • Build and evolve enterprise hiring strategies that balance speed, quality, cost, and long-term capability.
  • Provide strategic leadership for complex, high-priority, or business-critical searches, removing obstacles and guiding decision-making.
  • Define and evolve build-vs-buy and internal-vs-external talent strategies to support sustainable growth.
  • Partner closely with HRBPs and People leadership to align TA strategy with people plans, enable workforce planning and internal mobility, and ensure a smooth candidate-to-employee transition.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders on talent tradeoffs, market constraints, and organizational design considerations.
  • Enable and govern internal mobility to support retention, engagement, and capability development.
    •  
    Recruiting Operations & Process Excellence
  • Own the TA operating model, governance, and standards to ensure efficiency, quality, and scalability across the organization.
  • Ensure consistent, high-quality recruiting execution from intake and sourcing through assessment, offer, and close.
  • Be accountable for offer strategy, leveling consistency, and compensation governance, partnering closely with Compensation, Finance, and Legal.
  • Establish and scale best practices that support both speed and quality while managing risk.
  • Ensure recruiting practices align with legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Strengthen referral strategy and performance through cross-functional partnership and organizational engagement.
    •  
    Data, Insights & Forecasting
  • Own TA forecasting, scenario planning, and executive reporting to inform business decisions and priorities.
  • Establish success metrics tied to business impact, risk mitigation, and long-term capability.
  • Monitor recruiting performance and trends, identifying opportunities to improve outcomes and efficiency.
  • Use market intelligence to advise leaders on hiring challenges, competitive dynamics, and talent availability.
    •  
    TA Tools, Systems & Technology
  • Set strategic direction for the TA technology ecosystem to support scale, data integrity, and strong decision-making.
  • Partner with TA Operations and internal systems teams to drive adoption, consistent workflows, and high-quality reporting.
    •  
    Employer Branding
  • Partner with Employer Brand and Marketing teams to strengthen Hinge’s talent market positioning and ensure consistent, authentic messaging across channels.
    •  
    Stakeholder Management & Communication
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executives and senior leaders, proactively surfacing risks, insights, and recommendations.
  • Lead TA-related change management initiatives, ensuring clarity, alignment, and effective adoption across teams.
    •

• 10+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, including enterprise or multi-functional scope.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, including leading leaders or managing managers.
  • Proven ability to operate as a strategic partner to executive leadership.
  • Demonstrated success in workforce planning, forecasting, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Strong track record of building scalable TA organizations and driving operational excellence.
  • Deep understanding of competitive talent markets, especially within consumer tech.
  • High judgment, strong executive presence, and comfort navigating ambiguity and tradeoffs.
  • Strong emotional intelligence—empathetic listener who builds psychological safety and coaches others through change. 
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence executives and cross-functional partners.

description:
Match Group Shared Care and Moderation Services provides operational support for brands such as Tinder, Match.com, Meetic, OkCupid, Plenty of Fish, BLK, and many more. The department includes moderation and customer service operations, strategic support through teams like policy, knowledge management, customer experience, analytics, and delivers on key Trust and Safety and Customer Care KPIs. This department moves fast to build sustainable solutions that can support the growing business. 

We are seeking a visionary Director of Governance to serve as a strategic architect for trust and safety administration. In this role, you will lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for defining the rules of the road (Policy), ensuring our global workforce is equipped to enforce them (Training), and verifying that our execution remains world-class (Quality). A successful candidate will build the connective tissue ensuring safety standards are globally consistent, operationally lean, and future-proofed for an AI-driven landscape. This role is designed for a leader of leaders who enables teams to deliver high quality work built through cross-functional collaboration.

lists.content:
Strategic Vision & Ecosystem Governance

  • Long-Term Roadmap: Define and execute a multi-year governance strategy, establishing high-level KPIs and large-scale improvement goals that align with Match Group’s global portfolio.

  • Policy Stewardship: Lead the evolution of Trust & Safety policy strategy, ensuring a principled balance between platform values, global regulatory requirements (e.g., DSA), and emerging industry standards.

  • Executive Influence: Shape the internal narrative on risk mitigation and organizational impact; translate complex data into high-quality, ELT-ready materials for senior leadership.

    • Leadership & People Operations

  • Leading Leaders: Recruit, mentor, and scale a high-performing, multi-disciplinary team of managers across Policy, Training, and Quality functions.

  • Organizational Resilience: Build adaptable team structures and "BizOps" workflows that maintain high performance amidst shifting business demands and growth.

  • Culture of Rigor: Foster a professional environment rooted in deep domain expertise, transparency, and continuous development, ensuring the team is equipped to handle high-stakes safety challenges.

    • Operational Excellence & Lifecycle Management

  • Integrated Agent Lifecycle: Direct the strategic impact of the training ecosystem, ensuring global moderators are equipped with the nuance and SOPs required for high-accuracy enforcement.

  • Quality as Intelligence: Oversee a robust quality program that serves as a diagnostic tool, providing critical insights into the health of the moderation and customer care ecosystems.

  • Governance Frameworks: Build and maintain RACI models and escalation routines to clarify roles, align stakeholders, and enable decisive action.

    • Technical & Product Integration

  • Automation & HITL Strategy: Partner with Product and Engineering to co-design moderation tools, automation systems, and "human-in-the-loop" capabilities, ensuring governance insights drive technical roadmaps.

  • Data-Driven Decisioning: Drive analytical rigor within the team, converting feedback loops and workstream insights into actionable improvements for product and operational partners.

  • Post-Mortem & Audit Readiness: Lead comprehensive post-mortems and ensure all moderation and support processes are audit-ready and compliant with global legal mandates.

    • Risk Management & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Crisis & Incident Leadership: Monitor emerging risk signals and content trends; lead cross-functional incident response and crisis management efforts.

  • Operational Standards: Partner with Operations leadership to set the "Gold Standard" for moderation performance, ensuring quality rubrics drive operational alignment.

  • Influence Without Authority: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, driving solutions through strategic partnerships across Legal and Product.

lists.text: We Could Be a Match if You Have:
lists.content:
• 7+ years of experience in Trust & Safety, Content Policy, or Risk Management, with at least 4+ years of experience managing other people managers.
  • Proven experience leading high-performing, multi-disciplinary teams across multiple time zones and cultures; adept at managing asynchronous global operations without losing momentum.
  • Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, helping teams navigate "PR firestorms," regulatory shifts, and evolving business demands with composure.
  • Deep expertise in drafting, editing, and auditing moderation policies, agent training curricula, and quality assurance frameworks at an enterprise scale.
  • Advanced understanding of moderation tooling and automation, with the ability to navigate the complex trade-offs between algorithmic scale and human nuance.
  • Ability to partner effectively with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure all governance workstreams meet global regulatory requirements (e.g., DSA, UKOSA).
  • Proficiency in using data-driven storytelling to elevate the organizational narrative, turning raw "feedback loop" data into strategic insights for executive leadership.
  • Proven ability to oversee complex, cross-functional programs that impact millions of users across a diverse portfolio of brands.
  • A "systems thinker" capable of proposing new perspectives and scalable solutions to chronic platform integrity challenges.
  • Exceptional stakeholder engagement skills; able to build high-trust partnerships across Product, Engineering, Legal, Analytics, and Design.

#Hinge
descriptionPlain:
Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted

In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.


About the Role
 
We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Cloud Foundation team — the engineers responsible for AWS infrastructure, networking, IaC, and Kubernetes foundations that every Hinge product team builds on.
 

You'll directly manage the 5-person Cloud Foundation team and serve as the infrastructure discipline manager for ~3 Platform ICs embedded across other Platform teams, roughly 8 reports in total. As a member of the Platform leadership team, you'll approach infrastructure like a product — understanding the needs of your internal customers, shaping a roadmap that balances reliability and velocity, investing in the engineers behind the work, and staying close enough to the details to be a credible voice in design reviews and on-call retros.
 

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can balance team strategy and execution — growing a high-performing team while staying grounded in the technical work that drives developer velocity, reliability, and cost efficiency.

descriptionPlain:
Our Mission:
 
Launched in 2012, Tinder® revolutionized how people meet, growing from 1 match to one billion matches in just two years. This rapid growth demonstrates its ability to fulfill a fundamental human need: real connection. Today, the app has been downloaded over 630 million times, leading to over 97 billion matches, serving approximately 50 million users per month in 190 countries and 45+ languages - a scale unmatched by any other app in the category. In 2024, Tinder won four Effie Awards for its first-ever global brand campaign, “It Starts with a Swipe”™
 
 
Our Values:
Take the Lead
We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
 
Move Fast
We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
 
Better Together
We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
 
Real Talk
We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
 
Safety First
We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
 
Spark Fun
We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.

lists.content:
Match Group/Tinder is seeking an exceptionally organized, proactive, and discreet Executive Assistant to support the VP Marketing in charge of the EMEA region. The position can be based in Dublin (preferred) or London. This pivotal role is essential for maintaining smooth day-to-day operations in the region (with oﬃces also in Berlin, Paris and Madrid) and requires a proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial technology environment. If you are a seasoned professional ready to partner cross-functionally and manage complex priorities with precision and independence, we invite you to apply.

 

Where you’ll work:

This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three days per week. This position is located in Dublin, Ireland.

• Manage complex calendars, including cross-time-zone scheduling in the EMEA region and with U.S. (L.A. and N.Y.)
  • Being the main point of contact in EMEA for the EA Global team
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to interact with stakeholders at all levels, internally and externally
  • Prepare all EMEA meeting agendas and capture clear, actionable notes
  • Coordinate regional and international travel, including visas
  • Oversee expense management and budget tracking
  • Partner cross-functionally to streamline priorities and communications
  • Lead project coordination and support special initiatives
  • Support team culture, events, and logistics in a distributed environment
  • Act as the primary contact for local employees in the Dublin (or London) oﬃce, managing oﬃce supplies, special accommodation requests, and oﬃce occupancy planning, signing for deliveries/parcels.
  • Serve as a liaison with Match Group's corporate Sr. Director for Real Estate and Intl. Operations to address building maintenance or oﬃce needs, and coordinate with external vendors.
  • Coordinating with MG IT rep for employee IT and computer needs. Be the backup of the MG IT for local intervention or IT support.

descriptionPlain:
Our Mission:
 
Launched in 2012, Tinder® revolutionized how people meet, growing from 1 match to one billion matches in just two years. This rapid growth demonstrates its ability to fulfill a fundamental human need: real connection. Today, the app has been downloaded over 630 million times, leading to over 97 billion matches, serving approximately 50 million users per month in 190 countries and 45+ languages - a scale unmatched by any other app in the category. In 2024, Tinder won four Effie Awards for its first-ever global brand campaign, “It Starts with a Swipe”™
 
 
Our Values
Take the Lead
We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
Move Fast
We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
Better Together
We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
Real Talk
We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
Safety First
We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
Spark Fun
We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.


We’re looking for a Growth Product Marketing Lead to join the Tinder team.

Dating apps continue to be a connector for people who may not have otherwise met. You’ll be joining Tinder as it steers the evolution of the category to deliver on the needs of daters today, especially those who are newer or returning to dating.

As the Growth Product Marketing Lead, you’ll be at the center of how we engage consumers at scale, designing and driving forward product marketing strategy and execution across both in-app and out-of-app owned channels. This role will be critical in driving measurable results and setting up frameworks that help move curious daters through their respective journeys.

This is a highly cross-functional role across the entire org. If you’re excited about working on an app with global brand resonance and you find yourself splitting your time between flexing both your creative and analytical sides, this role could be for you.

Location: This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three days per week. This position is located in Los Angeles, CA, San Francisco, CA or New York, NY.

lists.content:
FEATURE GTM

  • Own the go-to-market strategy for new product features, develop feature positioning, messaging, and branding that will resonate with our audiences and differentiate our offerings in the market.
  • Collaborate across global teams to crystallize learning plans, translate strategies into marketing, and drive/measure impact.
  • Help define user needs and prioritize/deliver features that solve for them.

    •  

    GROWTH STRATEGY

    • Own organic growth strategies for Tinder globally, standing up channels and optimizing across the user journey and branded product touch points.
    • Recommend and form A/B tests and other experimental campaigns to refine ASO, CRM, LLM, app funnel tactics and improve return on investment. 
    • Establish KPIs for all programs, create results forecasts, track performance, and maintain project documentation.

      •  

      APP STORE OPTIMIZATION

      • Develop and execute a robust ASO strategy alongside our agency partners to improve app visibility and conversion rates in the app stores in key markets.
      • Bridge the gap between ASO strategy, in-app CRM, and our product roadmap by working across PMM, International and Localization teams to create mass-market relevance.
      • Own storytelling and discovery on App & Play Stores to drive accurate, timely feature awareness and improve Tinder’s share of voice.

        • GROWTH EXPANSION

        • Propose and develop new lifecycle CRM tactics in partnership with the Engagement team, including testing channels, messages, and audience segments to drive user success, engagement, and feature adoption.
        • Maintain a bridge between paid and owned strategies by collaborating with Media teams on product-related initiatives and forming holistic hypotheses.
        • Operationalize Tinder’s AI SEO strategy, and lead the application of learnings across the organization.
        • Own category exploration for new GTM strategies & product experiences that can unlock growth and bring in new users.

          •

• 6-8+ years of experience working in product marketing and leading full-funnel growth and go-to-market strategies, preferably in B2C and mobile apps.
  • You are consumer obsessed, lead with curiosity, and have formed methods for understanding the user journey and speaking to consumer needs across touchpoints.
  • You’re familiar with both tried & true and still-developing growth levers (including ASO, CRM, and AI search) and shaping them to maximize impact.
  • An analytical thinker and problem solver with a fluency in experimentation and ability to transfer that across key markets.

    •

• A highly collaborative teammate, capable of partnering across CRM, Marketing, Comms, Product, Design, Research, Analytics, Globalization, Strategy, Business Development, and Match Group portfolio teams to convert awareness to action and deepen product understanding and retention among users.
  • An eye to detail and a love for good design and user-centric experiences, balancing moving quickly and optimizations with what messaging and creative will be most inspirational and on brand.

opening:
Our Mission:
 
Launched in 2012, Tinder® revolutionized how people meet, growing from 1 match to one billion matches in just two years. This rapid growth demonstrates its ability to fulfill a fundamental human need: real connection. Today, the app has been downloaded over 630 million times, leading to over 97 billion matches, serving approximately 50 million users per month in 190 countries and 45+ languages - a scale unmatched by any other app in the category. In 2024, Tinder won four Effie Awards for its first-ever global brand campaign, “It Starts with a Swipe”™
 
 
Our Values

Take the Lead
We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.

Move Fast
We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.

Better Together
We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.

Real Talk
We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.

Safety First
We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.

Spark Fun
We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.

With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.


About the Role
 
The Head of Product & Tech Operations is a high-impact leadership position designed to own and evolve the unified operating system of our Product and Technology organizations. Reporting directly to the Chief Product and Technology Officer (CPTO), you will be the primary architect of how we work, ensuring our teams are faster, clearer, and more effective at scale.
 
This role merges Product and Tech operations into a single, coherent organization. Your mission is to eliminate organizational noise and duplication, allowing our functional leaders to focus on long-term strategy and innovation while you ensure the engine of the company runs with world-class precision.

lists.content:
• Own the Product & Tech Operating System: Define, document, and continuously evolve the end-to-end Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) as a single, integrated system.
  • Drive Execution Rigor & Planning: Lead the annual and quarterly planning cycles, ensuring alignment across Product, Engineering, and Design. Force early visibility and resolution of misalignments between cross-functional teams before they impact delivery.

  • Operationalize Innovation: Create the framework that allows high-risk, long-term bets to coexist with immediate delivery pressure without diluting either.
  • AI Tooling Enablement: Drive the strategy for AI workforce enablement to ensure our teams are leveraging the latest technology to improve productivity. Own vendor management and the selection, implementation, and governance of the tooling stack used across the Product–Tech organization.

• Proven Leadership: Extensive experience (typically 10+ years) in a senior leadership role within Product Operations, Engineering Operations, or Technical Program Management at a high-growth technology company.
  • Systems Thinking: A demonstrated ability to design complex organizational systems (PDLC/SDLC) that balance the need for discipline with the need for speed.
  • Strategic Execution: Experience leading large-scale annual and quarterly planning processes for organizations with hundreds of employees.
  • Change Management: Proven success in leading organizational transformations, merging teams, or redefining reporting structures and operating models.
  • Influence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with C-suite executives and SVPs to drive alignment.
  • Forward-Thinking: Experience or a strong interest in AI workforce enablement and modernizing the developer/product manager experience through better tooling.

 The MG Security Engineering organization provides unified security services across all Match Group brands. About Match Group

Match Group (NASDAQ: MTCH) is a leading provider of dating products across the globe, operating a portfolio of brands including Tinder, Hinge, Match, OkCupid, Pairs, Meetic, and more. With hundreds of millions of users worldwide generating billions of interactions daily, our scale demands world-class security operations.

About the Team

The MG Security Engineering organization provides unified security services across all Match Group brands. The Monitoring, Incident Response & SOC team is responsible for real-time threat detection, investigation, and response across the full portfolio — operating 24/7 to ensure security alerts are effectively triaged and responded to, minimizing the impact of potential threats.

lists.content:
As the Manager, IR / SOC, you will lead the integrated team responsible for Detection Engineering, Security Operations Center (SOC), and Incident Response (IR) across Match Group. Reporting to the Sr. Director of Security Engineering, you will drive the strategic vision of maximizing rapid and accurate threat response capabilities by integrating these three core functions and leveraging AI-driven innovation.

You will own the detection lifecycle end-to-end — from signal engineering and alert tuning through triage, investigation, and incident resolution — while building toward an AI-augmented SOC model that reduces noise, accelerates response, and scales across a global portfolio.

• Lead and develop a high-performing team of SOC analysts, detection engineers, and incident responders operating across multiple time zones with 24/7 coverage

  • Play a key role in developing the detection engineering framework, contributing to detections-as-code (DaC) via GitOps/CI/CD pipelines for consistency and automated deployment

  • Drive AI Agentic SOC adoption — evaluate, select, and implement AI-driven triage and investigation tooling to maximize SOC efficiency, reduce false positives, and accelerate initial response speed

  • Manage the full incident lifecycle — from detection through containment, eradication, recovery, and lessons learned — partnering with Legal, Communications, Privacy, and Engineering teams

  • Build and refine detection content across the SIEM platform, integrating log sources across all MG brands (Tinder, Hinge, Match, E&E, HPCNT, Eureka, and New Bets)

  • Establish and track SOC metrics and SLAs, creating dashboards to visualize performance, alert fidelity, and response effectiveness

  • Coordinate and execute IR tabletop exercises (technical and management-level) across brands to validate readiness and improve playbooks

  • Partner with the Red Team to validate detection capabilities through adversary simulation and assumed-compromise testing

  • Collaborate with Platform Security, InfraSec, and AppSec teams to identify and close detection gaps across cloud-native and hybrid environments (AWS, GCP), datacenter infrastructure, endpoints (CrowdStrike), identity (Okta), SaaS, and application layers

  • Integrate threat intelligence into detection and response workflows to anticipate and proactively defend against emerging threats

  • Use automation to improve detection and response times and mitigate incident impact

• 5+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or threat hunting, with 2+ years in a team leadership or management role
  • Proven experience building and operating a modern SOC in cloud-native and hybrid environments (AWS, GCP) and datacenter infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms and SOAR tools — including detection-as-code methodologies
  • Strong understanding of AI/ML applications in security operations — agentic SOC, automated triage, and intelligent alert enrichment
  • Experience managing the full incident lifecycle across complex, multi-brand or multi-tenant environments
  • Deep knowledge of attacker TTPs (MITRE ATT&CK), endpoint and network forensics, and threat hunting techniques
  • Experience with cloud security monitoring (AWS CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudWatch; GCP Security Command Center), datacenter security, and container orchestration security (Kubernetes)
  • Familiarity with identity and access security monitoring (Okta, SSO, MFA events)
  • Experience coordinating with external incident response teams, law enforcement, and cross-functional stakeholders during security events
  • Polished verbal and written communication skills — ability to communicate clearly during high-pressure incidents and deliver thorough post-incident reports to technical and executive audiences
  • Relevant certifications are a plus: GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, GSOM, CISSP, or equivalent

• Experience with Python-based detections and log analysis in modern cloud-native SIEM platforms
  • Background in the consumer internet/dating industry or other high-scale B2C platforms
  • Familiarity with Cloudflare (WAF, Bot Management), CrowdStrike, and SaaS security monitoring (Obsidian or similar)
  • Experience building or leading a Blue Team volunteer program or cross-functional security response team
